newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Rebels enter Zaire's diamond mining hub.
newsitem.headline: Rebels enter Zaire's diamond mining hub.

text.p: Rebels entered Zaire's diamond mining capital of Mbuji-Mayi on Friday, mining sources in the region said.
"We understand rebel forces have entered the town. It is in the process of changing hands," said one mining source who had been in radio contact with Mbuji-Mayi.
He said most Zairean troops who had been in the town appeared to have fled westward in stolen vehicles after looting shops and diamond traders' premises.
Traders in Zaire's second city of Lubumbashi said they had been in radio contact with colleagues in Mbuji-Mayi who said rebels had urged people to stay at home in broadcasts on local radio.
